title: Solid Snake (1995): playable identity distinct from Naked Snake
source_priority: Konami 1987 Metal Gear profiles and MSX2 manual
later Metal Gear canon as characterization continuity, not pre-1995 knowledge
contrast: Naked Snake foregrounds wilderness survival and formal CQC; 1995 Solid Snake foregrounds adapting to a military-industrial fortress, prisoners and equipment earned within it. Both are competent stealth operatives; neither lacks the other's skills.

traits.label: Lateral, observant problem-solver
traits.player_expression: Separate ways around a locked/guarded area; learn through door, sound, machinery and physical evidence
traits.critical_payoff: Items, discovered routes and prisoner clues acquired in earlier missions remain useful later
traits.anti_pattern: GPS marker or radio voice solves everything automatically

traits.label: Understated resilience
traits.player_expression: Under pressure, tactical decisions are reliable; a small restrained reaction, no premature superhero speeches
traits.critical_payoff: Even late betrayal gets concise reaction followed by player-driven action
traits.anti_pattern: Invincible swagger and dramatic threats at mission start

traits.label: Protective, compassionate in conduct
traits.player_expression: Rescue POWs and preserve hostage survival; suffering affects decisions and world state
traits.critical_payoff: Helping Ellen unlocks Madnar's cooperation; Jennifer's brother gives a credible final escape clue
traits.anti_pattern: Rescuing humans solely for points or showing sentimental monologues after every rescue

traits.label: Questions authority and learns to trust evidence
traits.player_expression: Early Big Boss advice is credible; later player can physically test the false advice and reject the abort order
traits.critical_payoff: Relationship shifts gradually from mentor-dependence to independent judgment
traits.anti_pattern: Early premature reveal or forced obedience to a visibly bad instruction

traits.label: Economical, opportunistic combat
traits.player_expression: Rear takedown, wall-to-wall movement, body dragging and rapid weapon-switching; obstacles and stealth are preferred over mandatory combat
traits.critical_payoff: Guard posture/awareness makes a grapple earned; equipment placement sets up boss counters
traits.anti_pattern: Treating Snake as a CQC-incompetent novice or a combat power-fantasy demigod

traits.label: Dry, pointed, sometimes incredulous
traits.player_expression: Brief questions clarify threats, expose evasive intelligence or provide humor without making him oblivious
traits.critical_payoff: Player hears doubts accumulate through codec as the fortress story unfolds
traits.anti_pattern: Parroting the last noun every line without narrative purpose

traits.label: Body-conscious, practical movement
traits.player_expression: Back to wall; measured footwork, corner peek, localized hand placement, drag weight, quiet controlled weapon presentation
traits.critical_payoff: Stealth movements communicate body position and sound to player without relying entirely on UI
traits.anti_pattern: Chest facing wall, moonwalking while dragging, teleporting bodies into lockers

traits.label: First field mission, but fully trained
traits.player_expression: Mechanics responsive from frame one; express inexperience through situations and authored choices, not artificial input lag
traits.critical_payoff: Growing confidence shown in earned radio reactions and clearer personal decisions
traits.anti_pattern: Make 1995 Snake incompetent, fall over or need arbitrary XP skills to do basic stealth

modernized_without_replacing_source: rear approach hold-to-choke and recoverable risk
slow heavy body dragging with geometry collision
industrial hiding lockers only where infrastructure permits
protected_lore: Naked Snake's CQC is not a reason Solid is ignorant of CQC
Big Boss's real command betrayal remains unresolved until earned
Gray Fox is the missing veteran not an always-on guide
Venom identity must not be known to Snake in 1995
early game Snake must not speak as his future Alaska-era self

mission_expressions.example: Scavenge gear, read guards at real jobs, free first prisoners and learn Outer Heaven with tangible uncertainty
Submit to capture to reach Gray Fox, improvise an exit, reclaim equipment; physical vulnerability not cutscene invulnerability
Earlier binoculars/gas mask/card/POW intel support multiple revisits and reward corroboration
Jennifer's legitimate aid and researched enemy weaknesses should be earned, not gifted by scripted loadouts
Prioritize Ellen's rescue before Madnar's technical disclosure; physically revisit earlier detention rooms
Detect contradictions in Big Boss's truck/door guidance; save Jennifer's brother during Coward Duck encounter
A prisoner corroborates command deception and Snake knowingly refuses the abort order
TX-55 sabotage uses Fox and Madnar intelligence; left escape ladder pays off earlier hostage rescue, final report understated

production_gates: No character personality trait may replace a source-critical equipment or prisoner gate
Movement is responsive at mission start; character growth occurs through learned world use, not locked basic controls
Every stealth animation state has a gameplay counterpart with collision, perception and timing
Back-to-wall requires surface normal orientation, side-slide, corner behavior and camera tests
Rescues change people and later mission outcomes without inventing unsupported canonical dialogue
Check subtitles, audio-free alternatives, gamepad prompts and save/reload on every trait expression
Mark what is actually in Unreal as source-only/uncompiled until engine tests pass
